name: Should I repair or replace my entire wood fence?

mainEntity.name: Should I repair or replace my entire wood fence?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace your wood fence depends on the overall condition of the fence. If only a few sections are damaged, repair is often the more cost-effective option. However, if more than 25-30% of the fence is compromised by rot, extensive damage, or structural instability, a full replacement might be a better long-term investment. We can help you assess the condition and recommend the best solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Decide to repair or replace your wood fence based on the extent of damage; repair for minor issues, replacement for widespread compromise.
